# highlight.js

Bundled version: 11.9.0 (BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE).

Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/tree/11.9.0

The common browser build includes C++ and Bash grammars. The site loads this local
file before app.js; syntax colors live in style.css. No CDN is required at runtime.
